maddeler.e:
استوحيا (form X)
# اِسْتَوْحَيَا (istawḥayā) /is.taw.ħa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَوْحَى (istawḥā)
# اُسْتُوحِيَا (ustūḥiyā) /us.tuː.ħi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَوْحَى (istawḥā)
# اِسْتَوْحِيَا (istawḥiyā) /is.taw.ħi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَوْحَى (istawḥā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
